name: Nuvora AIO Blocks – Page Builder Toolkit for the Block Editor
author: Sehrish Anam

sections.description:
Nuvora AIO Blocks is a powerful WordPress plugin that transforms the way you build with the Gutenberg block editor. Purpose-built for the native WordPress block editor — no page builders required — it delivers 6 beautifully designed, fully customizable blocks that give you total creative control over your website.

Whether you’re building a business site, portfolio, landing page, or blog, Nuvora AIO Blocks provides everything you need to create stunning, professional-grade pages right inside the editor you already know.

Join the Nuvora movement today and build your website with ease.

Key Features That Enhance and Extend WordPress Blocks

  • 6 Advanced Blocks — Counter, Pricing Table, Testimonial Carousel, Advanced Tabs, Icon Box, Slider
  • Multiple Layout Styles per block (4–5 styles each)
  • Full Color Controls for every block
  • Full Typography Controls — font size, font weight, and more
  • Padding, Border Radius, and Border Controls
  • Live Preview directly in the block editor
  • Clean, Lightweight Output — zero bloat, zero dependencies
  • Fully Responsive and Mobile-Friendly
  • Works natively with the WordPress Block Editor — no page builder needed

Blocks Overview

Nuvora AIO Blocks gives you 6 powerful, beautifully designed blocks for the WordPress block editor. Each block ships with multiple styles and full design controls — built natively for the block editor.

Nuvora Counter Block

Showcase your achievements and milestones with style. The Counter block features a smooth animated count-up effect, 5 unique layout styles, 12 built-in icons, prefix/suffix support, easing animation options, and full typography and color controls. Perfect for displaying stats, numbers, and key metrics that captivate your audience at a glance.

Nuvora Pricing Table

Convert visitors into customers with a fully customizable, conversion-focused pricing block. Choose from 4 distinct styles, add a gradient header, build out your feature list, highlight a recommended plan with a badge, set a CTA button, and display strikethrough pricing for promotions and sales. Everything you need to present your pricing clearly and professionally.

Nuvora Testimonial Carousel

Build trust and credibility with an elegant, touch-friendly testimonial slider. Display customer reviews with avatars and star ratings, enable autoplay, and let visitors swipe through testimonials naturally on mobile. Comes with 4 card styles to match any design aesthetic. The perfect social proof block for any business or service site.

Nuvora Advanced Tabs

Elevate your content organization with a sophisticated tabbed interface. Each tab supports a title, description, and per-tab icon and color for a truly personalized experience. Choose from 4 stunning styles — Solid, Underline, Pills, and Card Tabs — to match your site’s look and feel. Ideal for FAQs, feature comparisons, service breakdowns, and more.

Nuvora Icon Box

Highlight your services, features, or key benefits with eye-catching icon boxes. Each item supports a heading, description, icon, and custom color. Choose from 4 card styles, set icon position to top, left, or right, pick from multiple shape options, and use the built-in repeater to add unlimited items — all without writing a single line of code.

Nuvora Slider

Immerse your audience in captivating visuals with a full-featured slider and carousel block. Choose from 4 animation types, enable full-width or hero mode, add captions and CTA buttons to each slide, turn on autoplay, and even pull in your Latest Posts dynamically. Whether you need a homepage hero banner or a content carousel, Nuvora Slider has you covered.

Every block includes:
* Multiple layout styles (4–5 per block)
* Full color controls
* Full typography controls (size, weight)
* Padding, border radius, and border controls
* Live preview in the block editor
* Clean, lightweight output — no bloat

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nuvora-aio-blocks folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. In the block editor, search for Nuvora to find all blocks.
sections.faq:
Does this require any page builder?

No. All Nuvora blocks work natively with the WordPress block editor. No Elementor, Divi, or any other page builder is needed.

Will you add more blocks?

Yes! Nuvora AIO Blocks is designed to grow. More blocks with more styles and features are actively planned for upcoming releases.

Are these blocks responsive?

Yes, every block is fully responsive and mobile-friendly out of the box. No extra configuration needed.

Can I customize the look of each block?

Absolutely. Every block includes full controls for colors, typography, padding, border radius, and borders — all with live preview inside the block editor.

Does Nuvora AIO Blocks slow down my website?

No. Nuvora is built with a clean, lightweight approach. Only the assets required for the blocks you actually use are loaded — no bloat, no unnecessary scripts.

Is Nuvora AIO Blocks compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes. Nuvora AIO Blocks is designed to work with any WordPress theme, including Full Site Editing (FSE) themes.
